description: Australian-gifted Avon Sabre that served the TNI-AU from 1973. Unveiled 15 August 1981 on the roundabout in front of the Riau governor's office, dismantled and re-erected at Gedung Juang 45 in October 2011. A 2020 report said the Riau government had been asked to move it again, into the Lanud Roesmin Nurjadin compound; whether that move happened is unconfirmed. Serial not published; the marking 'J388' quoted by one blog is not a TNI-AU serial.
